source.note: Set structure and direct-pack insert families were cross-checked against public reference pages. Base printer/copyright variations are intentionally collapsed to one canonical VCS card per printed card number. Factory-only, mail-in, promotional, and box-bottom material are excluded from normal VCS packs.

decisions.packChannelAbstraction: VCS uses one universal 15-card pack. Three direct-pack insert families were originally exclusive to different physical pack formats, so their VCS odds are normalized by card volume rather than treated as literal wax-pack odds.

normalizedInsertOdds.glossyAllStars: 1 per 43-card rack pack -> approximately 1 per 2.87 VCS 15-card packs -> stored as 1:3
normalizedInsertOdds.glossyRookies: 1 per 100-card jumbo pack -> approximately 1 per 6.67 VCS 15-card packs -> stored as 1:7
normalizedInsertOdds.battingLeaders: 1 per 100-card K-Mart blister -> approximately 1 per 6.67 VCS 15-card packs -> stored as 1:7

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: One canonical VCS card per printed number 1-792. Minor copyright/printer variants are not modeled as separate cards.

productSets.name: Glossy All-Stars
productSets.notes: Originally one per 43-card rack pack. VCS universal-pack odds are normalized to a 15-card pack by card volume, approximately 1:3.

productSets.name: Glossy Rookies
productSets.notes: Originally one per 100-card supermarket jumbo pack. VCS universal-pack odds are normalized to a 15-card pack by card volume, approximately 1:7.

productSets.name: Batting Leaders
productSets.notes: Originally one per 100-card K-Mart blister. VCS universal-pack odds are normalized to a 15-card pack by card volume, approximately 1:7.
